abilities.name: Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost
_curatorNotes: Heal effects authored 2026-07-12 for the 'tag without effect' audit finding (skill tagged heal). Two heal mechanisms, both ATK-scaled and snapshot at cast in gcsim (c.skillHealSnapshot).

On-hit heal ('Regeneration on Hit'): gcsim burst.go onNACAHitHook() fires c.Core.Player.Heal on every Qiqi Normal/Charged hit (AttackTagNormal | AttackTagExtra) while skillBuffKey ('qiqi-e') is active. Target -1 = whole party → target 'team'; gated on Herald of Frost active → condition state 'duringSummon'. Authored as two effects (onHit abilityType normal + charged) since the onHit trigger takes a single abilityType. TL10 (index 9): skillHealOnHitPer[9]=0.19008 → 19.008% ATK, skillHealOnHitFlat[9]=148.30853 (sidecar 'Regeneration on Hit' col 10 = '19.01% ATK+148').

Continuous heal ('Continuous Regeneration'): gcsim skill.go — one proc immediately at skillHitmark=32 (= summon spawnsAt), then skillHealTickTask re-queues every 4.5*60=270f. Authored as a summonTick on the Herald of Frost summon (Kuki ring / Diona heal-tick shape), interval 4.5, firstTickDelay 0 for the immediate-on-spawn proc → ~4 ticks over the 15s window (0/4.5/9/13.5s; gcsim comment '3 additional times'). Target c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active'. TL10 (index 9): skillHealContPer[9]=1.2528 → 125.28% ATK, skillHealContFlat[9]=991.2866 (sidecar 'Continuous Regeneration' col 10 = '125.28% ATK+991').

Herald of Frost's Cryo coordinated-attack DMG ticks (Skill Damage / Coordinated Attack DMG sidecar rows) are NOT authored here — out of scope for this heal-only finding; the skill is not tagged coordinatedAttack.

STELLAR ROUND 2026-07-29 — CD PATCH. The Witch's Revelation passive 'Seven Sacred Treasures' (Fandom, Luna VIII) reduces this skill's cooldown to 15s with NO Stellar gate (no 'Radiance:' prefix, no Polestar Field wording) — a permanent kit patch once the Witch's Revelation quest is completed (requires owning Qiqi at Lv. 70+). Authored as an unconditional cooldownModifiers entry (flat -15) rather than editing the base `cooldown`, so the canonical 30s stays intact for the genshin-db scalar diff and the source of the reduction is attributed. Fandom gameplay note: it does not lower the BASE cooldown — it subtracts 15s from the remaining cooldown the moment the skill is used, and that subtraction is unaffected by party-wide CD reduction such as Anemo Resonance (so with resonance the real result is 30×0.95−15 = 13.5s). ↻ 2026-09-18: Anemo Resonance is applied by the parser now, as a team skill-cooldown modifier that runs BEFORE an ability's own flat modifiers — measured 13.5s in a Kazuha + Venti party, the divergence this note used to accept is closed.

STELLAR ROUND 2026-07-29 — the enhanced (buff-field) talent text adds: 'If your current active character hits an opponent with an attack, the Herald of Frost will perform a coordinated attack on the opponent, dealing Cryo DMG' (Herald of Frost Coordinated Attack DMG 24–54%, TL10 = 43.2%, 2.2s CD). NOT Radiance-gated (no such prefix) → permanent once the Revelation is unlocked. Damage magnitude → caveat only, no effect. The `coordinatedAttack` tag was deliberately NOT added: it would derive a new off-field-DMG capability at C0 that the audit fixture does not expect, and the underlying Herald damage is still unauthored. Flag for a follow-up capability pass.
abilities.description:
Using the Icevein Talisman, Qiqi brings forth the Herald of Frost, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.

Herald of Frost
·On hit, Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attacks regenerate HP for your own party members and nearby teammates. Healing scales based on Qiqi's ATK.
·Periodically regenerates your active character's HP.
·Follows the character around, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in their path.
abilities.caveat: The 15s cooldown assumes the Witch's Revelation talent Seven Sacred Treasures is unlocked; without it the cooldown is 30s. Not modeled: the Herald's coordinated attacks on the active character's hits.

abilities.name: Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune
_curatorNotes: Fortune-Preserving Talisman is an enemy-attached status effect modeled as a summon (no mobility field, per Mona Illusory Bubble precedent). spawnsAt=40 from talismanAi QueueAttack(…, 40, 40, talismanCB) in burst.go, which fires before main DMG at burstHitmark=82. Duration 15s from e.AddStatus(talismanKey, 15*60).

STELLAR ROUND 2026-07-29. Enhanced (buff-field) text, Fandom 'Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune': 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Deals an additional instance of Cryo DMG that is also considered Stellar-Conduct DMG.' Stellar-Conduct DMG scaling row 297.3–669%, TL10 = 535.2%; Advanced Properties list it as a separate 0U, no-ICD instance. Page category 'Direct Stellar-Conduct Talents' — damage magnitude, so caveat + note only, never a damage effect (same call as Sandrone C4). Gate is the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state (Qiqi inside a Polestar Field), narrower than a teamEnablesReaction condition would express — nothing authored, so no gate needed here.

GAUGE ROUND 2026-08-17. The Talisman summon is NOT a tick series — gcsim's burst.go has no QueueCharTask/Tasks.Add on a period; the only thing the talismanKey status drives is talismanHealHook (heal to whoever damages the marked enemy, 1s ICD via talismanICDKey), which is healing, not damage, and is driven by the party's hits rather than a timer. Nothing added to summons[].effects. The burst's OWN Cryo hit was missing from application[] and is now authored: burst.go const burstHitmark = 82, ai{Element: attributes.Cryo, Durability: 50, Mult: burstDmg[c.TalentLvlBurst()]} → frame 82, cryo, 50/25 = 2U. The frame-40 entry stays element-less on purpose: talismanAi is AttackTagNone/ICDTagNone with Element attributes.Physical and no Mult (application-only marker attack).

STILL UNAUTHORED (pre-existing, unchanged by this round): the burst's own Talisman healing, 90–203% ATK+577–1,703 (TL10 = 162% ATK+1,270), once per second, active character only and only when they hit the marked target.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — — it talks about an extra DAMAGE instance. The curator note records it as a separate 0U, no-ICD instance, so even the aura lane would gain no pip from it, and damage magnitude is FROZEN out of scope tool-wide. Nothing on the timeline is wrong or missing whether the talent is unlocked or not. Category: invisible-omission.

passives.name: Life-Prolonging Methods
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. A1: when the active char is under Herald of Frost and triggers any elemental reaction, they gain +20% IncomingHealingBonus for 8s. gcsim subscribes to all reaction events (ReactionEventStartDelim+1 through ReactionEventEndDelim) and checks skillBuffKey active (asc.go:a1()). Probable trigger: onReaction with condition that Herald of Frost is active; reaction list needs KQM verification.

↻ AUTHORED 2026-09-16 (T0.5) — the "needs reviewer pass" above is closed. `incomingHealingBonus` already exists as a Stat and the trigger needed no new primitive: `reaction: 'any'` and `source: 'active'` are both in the union, and 'active' is the right one — gcsim requires atk.Info.ActorIndex == Player.ActiveChar().Index(), and 'team' would let the Herald's own swipes grant it.

⚠️⚠️ AUTHORED FROM THE KIT TEXT, NOT FROM gcsim, ON PURPOSE — gcsim's gate is INVERTED. `asc.go:19-22` opens with `if c.StatusIsActive(skillBuffKey) { return }`, i.e. it grants the bonus when the Herald of Frost is NOT out, where the talent says "a character under the effects of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost". We author `state: duringSummon`, which is the kit. ⛔ Don't 'fix' this toward the oracle. ⚠️ The gate renders optimistically today (a `state` condition is unresolvable on the buff passes, §1.G), so the bar draws off any reaction the active character triggers whether or not the Herald is up.

↻ RESOLVED (state-gates round §1.G, 2026-09-19 — `docs/state-gates-round.md`). Two things were wrong with the note above, not one. The gate: the reaction buff pass now reads Qiqi's `duringSummon` at the reaction. And the SOURCE: `source: 'active'` had no reader in the buff pass and fell through to Qiqi's OWN reactions, so the bar did not "draw optimistically" — it drew for nobody but Qiqi. It is now every reaction the controlled character causes with their own cast or swing (`ReactionEvent.viaEntity` refuses a tick). Measured: `Qiqi E > Bennett E N1` draws 1.35→9.35s on Bennett; with no Herald, or 16s later, nothing; the Herald's own tick reactions draw nothing.

Unlocked by the Witch's Revelation system, not by ascension: own Qiqi at Lv. 70+ and complete the quest chain. Absent from genshin-db, authored from the Fandom talent page alone (gcsim has no Stellar implementation) — wiki-alone evidence sanctioned by Nate for this round.

Line 1 (permanent, no Radiance prefix): skill cooldown reduced to 15s → authored on the skill as a cooldownModifiers flat -15; see that ability's notes for the remaining-CD mechanic and the Anemo-Resonance interaction.

Line 2 (Radiance-gated): 'While the Herald of Frost is on the field, characters in Qiqi's party have their Superconduct and Stellar-Conduct Reaction DMG increased by 50%.' AUTHORED 2026-07-29 per Nate's bucket-5 ruling as two team buffs on the new Reaction-Bonus stat family (superConductReactionBonus + stellarConductReactionBonus, bucket 5 — additive with the EM bonus; Fandom categories 'Superconduct DMG Bonus Talents' + 'Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus Talents' map there). Trigger onCast skill, 15s = the Herald's duration; both halves ride teamEnablesReaction since the whole clause is Radiance-gated. _curatorNotes: trigger: 'manual' is inherited from generator; reviewer to replace. In gcsim, c1() callback is appended to Herald tick AttackEvents and checks e.StatusIsActive(talismanKey) (cons.go:c1()). Energy +2 per qualifying hit; no per-hit ICD modeled in gcsim. Target scope: self.

STELLAR ROUND 2026-07-29 — second effect ADDED. Enhanced (buff-field) text, Fandom 'Ascetics of Frost': 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Qiqi also regenerates 6 Elemental Energy when the Herald of Frost's attacks and coordinated attacks hit opponents. This effect can trigger once every 6s.' Authored as a second energy effect (6, self, procCooldown 6) gated on `teamEnablesReaction: stellarConduct`; the base 2-Energy effect is untouched. trigger 'manual' mirrors the sibling effect — the Herald's ticks and its new coordinated attacks are not authored damage, so no onHit trigger could fire. Real gate is narrower (Radiance state = Qiqi inside a Polestar Field), stated in the caveat.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — — it talks about ENERGY regeneration. The planner has no energy surface at all: both effects are `energy` on a `manual` trigger (nothing consumes manual, and energy effects have no planner consumer even on wired triggers), and no bar, marker, counter or tooltip anywhere prints energy gained. C1 — Ascetics of Frost — effects[0] (energy 2, self) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `internal/characters/qiqi/cons.go:13-26` (`c1`) — an `AttackCB` appended to each Herald of Frost damage swipe (`skill.go:131-132`) that returns unless the struck enemy has `talismanKey` active, then `AddEnergy("qiqi-c1", 2)`. The Herald's missing damage series belongs to the summon-tick-gaps backlog, not to this round.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 — Ascetics of Frost — effects[1] (energy 6, self, stellarConduct-gated) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: absent from gcsim — the Herald's coordinated attacks and the whole Radiance upgrade are a Witch's-Revelation addition with no Go implementation; `cons.go:13-26` carries only the base 2-Energy arm. The same option applies here (the in-game scope is ONE ally, the lowest HP% nearby, not the team), and the alternative — leaving the effect and narrowing `target` — is no better, since no target primitive picks the lowest-HP member and `active` would be a different wrong claim. ⛔ Not changed here: this pass is notes only. ↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — on the surface this caveat reaches. The heal is `trigger: manual` — 167 manual effects corpus-wide draw no bar, no marker, no chip — and its parent Talisman heal is unauthored too, so the planner shows nothing to be wrong about. The enemy ATK debuff likewise has no lane. ⚠️ The character's own curator note is right that the WRONG `target: 'team'` reaches deriveCapabilities and makes the Team Builder claim a party-wide C4 heal — but N17 is decisive: an authored caveat renders only in the planner's Notes panel and can never reach that card. constellations.name: Rite of Resurrection
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onCast burst 2026-05-09 (F1). 50% MaxHP team heal authored. The revival mechanic (dead → alive) is outside the current schema; the 15min ICD is not modeled (gcsim doesn't enforce it either). Heal portion only.

STELLAR ROUND 2026-07-29 — nothing authored. Enhanced (buff-field) text, Fandom 'Rite of Resurrection': after the burst Qiqi gains 4 stacks of Glimpse of Mystery (12s, refreshed by re-casting the burst); when the current active character OTHER than Qiqi deals Stellar-Conduct DMG, 1 stack is consumed and that DMG is increased by 600% of Qiqi's ATK. Fandom utility tag: 'Stellar-Conduct Additive Base DMG Bonus' — the additive-base-DMG term of the Stellar formula, i.e. damage magnitude, not a stat buff, so no effect (constitution).
